warning.titlePre: Land Rover Freelander SD4 Injector & DPF Issues
paragraphs: Freelander SD4 engines — Ford Duratorq 2.2L units across the L359 generation — commonly show injector failure and DPF clogging. We replace injectors, EGR valves and gaskets as standard on every Duratorq rebuild.
